craft_notes: Sthāyin: arrival at the door (brow, brahma-door, then flight). Sanskrit first: two high stations (brow-Īśa, door-Sadāśiva), then swift going to the unsupported → L4 sets stations line 1, waking+flight line 2. Rows: row 1 (Śiva last — anāśritaṃ śivam closes the verse, Śiva closes the song-line). Rupture: dash after 'door' — stations done, flight begins. Close: colon landing on the name (crowning, per stava method). Minimal pass: 'crown's door' for brahmadvāra (singable); 'stateless shore' for anāśrita (supportless as shore — image added, doctrine kept). Read aloud: line 1 names high (Īśa/Sadāśiva full vowels), dash, line 2 flies (wake/rise/swift short). Rejected: 'unsupported state' flat — killed: L4 must sing, 'shore' carries supportlessness; exclaiming the name — killed: colon crowns.

lines: Īśa between the brows, Sadāśiva at the crown's door —
wake them, rise swift to the shore that rests on nothing: Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhruvormadhyagataṃ tv īśaṃ brahmadvāre sadāśivam / bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam

reads_against.argmap: The climb ends past brow and brahma-door in the unsupported Śiva state.
c1_essence: Brow-Īśa, brahma-door Sadāśiva — wakened, then flight to unsupported Śiva.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
